product.name: AI-Powered Session Replay Analysis
product.description: Analyzes user session replays using AI to identify key moments, user behaviors, and feature engagement without manual review.

product.name: AI-Driven Error and Bug Detection
product.description: Automatically detects, prioritizes, and notifies teams about critical bugs, errors, and abnormal product behaviors impacting users.

product.name: Customer and Account Usage Insights
product.description: Provides detailed analytics on how individual customers and accounts use product features, including churn risk and engagement metrics.
